rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for Headings.
Use tracking-tight for all headings above 32px.
Never center-align paragraphs; left-align forms, lists, and dense content.
Tinted Grey Rule: Neutral greys are subtly tinted cool (slate).
Ensure Normal Text has a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Interactive elements must have high contrast hover states, e.g., hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white.
Focus rings should use primary color, e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px subtle bottom border border-slate-200/50. NO FULLY TRANSPARENT HEADERS.
surfaces.cards: Neumorphism Tactile: Flat background, 1px subtle border, sharp inner contrasts, subtle ambient shadow (shadow-sm) on hover.
surfaces.tables: Grid Borders: Technical look with border-b on rows, minimal spacing to increase density.

spacing: Use generous spacing: 2-3x typical padding. Prefer p-6 or p-8 inside cards.
Containers with borders MUST have padding on text content to avoid collision.

layouts.strategy: The Bento Grid & High Density Mode
grids: High Density Dashboard: Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-6.
Settings Layout: Use a 2-column setup on desktop (Sidebar nav + Main content area) or dense forms inside card containers.
alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical (e.g., icons next to text).

rules: No universal transitions (e.g., transition-all). Target specific properties: transition-colors, transition-opacity, transition-transform.
Hover States: Slight lift (-translate-y-[2px]) and shadow-md on cards.
Buttons: Scale down slightly on active (active:scale-95).
All interactive elements MUST have visible focus states.
Use data-testid attributes for ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='logo-upload-input', data-testid='save-company-btn').
Ensure proper aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like the logo remove button).

component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Label. Make inputs dense (h-10) with crisp borders.
component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast brand primary for CTAs.
component_rules.tables: Shadcn Table for invoice history. Hover states on rows.
component_rules.toasts: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g., 'Logo uploaded successfully', 'File too large').
component_rules.icons: Use lucide-react for all standard icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Include a 'Company Logo' upload field using an <input type='file' accept='image/jpeg, image/png, image/svg+xml' />.
Enforce a 2 MB file size limit with a clear error message (via Sonner toast) if exceeded.
Show a live logo preview using an object URL before the user saves.
Provide buttons to Replace and Remove the uploaded logo.
Save the company profile along with the uploaded logo (store the file appropriately and save its path/URL in MongoDB).
Display the uploaded logo in: 1. Application Header, 2. Invoice Preview, 3. Printed Invoice, 4. PDF Invoice.
If no logo exists, display the company name as a fallback in the Application Header and invoices.
No hardcoded dummy images in production.
Create the My Company profile form fields (Name, Address, Tax ID, Email, Phone).
Ensure the header layout handles the logo elegantly (max height ~40px).
Always apply a `data-testid` to buttons, inputs, and major containers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with proper z-index.
NEVER use generic emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize Shadcn UI components from src/components/ui/.
Override default component sizing if it prevents content from fitting naturally.
Do not add .App { text-align: center; } to global CSS.
